pages.rationale: Every region, row, chip and lock in frame 12 is present in the right order with the right copy; the save bar, dirty-row dot/outline and Saved toast all work. Both previous P1s are fixed: each control now derives its own consequence sentence. Deduction only for right-hand captions the frame does not draw, which push the include chips onto a second line.

findings.title: prev fixed: include-row consequence is a constant
findings.detail: Toggling notes on now reads '1 unsaved change - family exports now carry notes - exports already written are unchanged'; turning the omitted list off reads 'family exports stop carrying omitted list - the grouping is harder to read without it; exports already written keep it'. Each include chip derives its own sentence.

findings.title: prev fixed: other export edits produce raw list-diff consequences
findings.detail: atlas SVG gives 'every family export also writes atlas SVG - one file per format'; null draws 'the reproducibility bundle now carries null draws - the zip grows; a rerun has more of what it needs'; carry exemplars 'seed templates export without their exemplar windows'; parquet 'window sets are written as parquet - columnar, readable outside Python; npz readers need converting'; reports layout 'run reports write one file per stage'. No 'applies to new runs' and no list diffs remain; the Saved toast repeats the same sentence.

findings.title: Right-hand captions added to rows the frame leaves bare
findings.detail: The app adds 'one file per format' beside formats and 'hand edits and the omitted list make the grouping readable' beside include (also 'the split plan is what makes a window set reusable'). Frame 12 draws none of these; the include caption squeezes the chip row so nine chips wrap onto two lines where the frame keeps one. That caption is also static - it still says hand edits make the grouping readable when hand edits are off.

findings.title: Model-card lock drawn as an extra 'always' chip
findings.detail: Frame 12 draws the model-card toggle on with a bare lock glyph beside it; the app adds a grey chip reading 'always'. Small extra furniture on an otherwise exact row.

pages.rationale: All five cards of frame 15 are present with the right rows, controls and proportions, and the report preview is now genuinely live: line width, grid opacity, font and the transparent ground all redraw, and density really does tighten rows. Deductions: the family palette's tenth swatch is the run-A blue from the same page, which 'no semantic hues' and D8 forbid; the clock-time readout uses an invented recording start; and two copy/axis differences from the frame.

findings.title: prev fixed: report-figure preview ignores line width, grid opacity and background
findings.detail: Line width 2.5 now sets the path stroke-width to 2.5 (was a fixed 1), grid opacity writes --fig-grid 0.15 to 0.65, the font select restyles the axis text, and 'transparent' swaps the white ground for a checkerboard instead of recolouring the trace. Caption and picture agree.

findings.title: prev fixed: density 'compact' changes nothing
findings.detail: Clicking compact sets html[data-density]=compact and the settings-nav row height drops from 30 px to 24 px; the toast 'Applied to this browser' is now truthful.

findings.title: prev NOT fixed (now disclosed): units still change nothing outside this page
findings.detail: A new 'a readout in this format' row does respond - clock time gives '27 Jul 16:07:30', uV gives '-82 uV', sample indices adds 'sample 112,050'. Nothing else on the site follows, but the caption now admits 'pages pick this up as each is wired - the Explore and Review readouts still read hours - mV today', so the gap is stated rather than closed.

findings.title: Family palette's last swatch is the run-A blue, against D8
findings.detail: DisplayPage.tsx PALETTE ends '#1F8A70', '#2F6FEB'; #2F6FEB is exactly the 'run A' role colour drawn two rows above, and #1F8A70 is a saturated green. Section 3 / D8 says the family palette avoids pure red, green and blue so a family colour never reads as a verdict or origin, and the select itself says 'no semantic hues - 10'. Four swatches also diverge from the canon family colours (#8B5CF6 for F-01 #5856D6, #5AC8FA for F-06 #64D2FF, #8E8E93 for F-07 #7A8FA6, #8B4A3B for F-08 #6D4C41) and canon #8E9C3A is absent.

findings.title: Clock-time readout uses an invented recording start
findings.detail: RECORDING_START is hard-coded to 2026-07-26T09:00, so 31.1250 h reads '27 Jul 16:07:30'. Canon section 0 puts M2_aug's start at 2025-08-02 14:00, which would read 3 Aug 21:07:30. The sample index (112,050 at 1 Hz) is consistent; only the date is off canon.

findings.title: Units card subtitle and preview axis differ from the frame
findings.detail: Frame 15 subtitles the card 'every readout on every page, not only plots' (spec 9.15, units site-wide); the app reads 'the format every readout uses - times, amplitudes, indices'. The preview axis is labelled 0.0000 h / 0.0278 h / 0.0556 h / 0.0833 h / 0.1111 h where the frame draws just '0 h' and '45 h' at the corners - four-decimal sub-minute ticks on a figure the frame shows as a 45 h trace.

findings.title: Stacked toasts sit on top of the View sizes controls
findings.detail: Three 'Applied to this browser' toasts stack bottom-centre and cover the Review context padding segments and the members-per-page field until they expire; the frame has no overlay there.

pages.rationale: Frame 16 is reproduced row for row - ten key rows with the right chips, the 'where' column, the two 'set in Vocabulary' links, the conflict badge and all six behaviour rows with their captions. Every interaction the frame implies now works: capture takes focus on the first click, a conflict raises the red row with Keep/Move, a locked owner refuses the move with a reason and an Open Vocabulary link, and the leave guard follows its toggle. One small visual deduction.

findings.title: prev fixed: key capture does not take focus
findings.detail: Clicking the Space cell of 'skip without writing' now puts document.activeElement on SPAN/capture-skip; pressing q immediately rebinds the row to Q and the badge stays 'no conflicts'. No second click needed.

findings.title: prev fixed: moving a key off a locked verdict bound it twice
findings.detail: Capturing S on 'mark viewport reviewed' now shows 'S is bound to verdicts S I N A U. A key does one thing.' plus 'verdicts ... is set in Vocabulary - change it there, then rebind here.', an Open Vocabulary button, and 'Move S here' disabled. The badge reads '1 conflict' in red and the row keeps R.

findings.title: prev fixed: 'confirm before leaving unsaved settings' toggle had no effect
findings.detail: With the toggle off, editing Export and clicking About navigates straight to #/settings/about with no guard. With it on, the guard opens: 'Leave with 1 unsaved change?' plus the consequence and 'from Keyboard & behaviour - confirm before leaving unsaved settings (turn it off there to leave without asking)'.

findings.title: Locked 'undo reverses a whole batch' toggle reads as off
findings.detail: The locked toggle renders its knob at the left of the green track with the lock glyph to its right, so the row looks switched off; frame 16 draws it as an on toggle (knob right) with the lock beside it. Its aria-label is 'on - enforced', so only the picture is wrong.
